blurb: Islesford Artists was opened in 1986 to enable the community and its visitors to become more familiar with the art of friends and neighbors on Little Cranberry Island. Today, we exhibit the work of these artists, as well as artists from other Maine islands. The artists represent a wide range of work from realistic to abstract in style. Each has special feelings for their island homes off the Maine coast.
